title: fix(objectql): os migrate plan runs the activation ledger backfill as a dry run instead of blaming a plugin for its write
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLcR66HDKGmkegYSEN3PSwY)_

Fixes #32096

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** CLI 的一次性启动(`os migrate plan` / `apply` / `stored-references` 等所有走 `bootSchemaStack` 的命令)不再执行激活台账的 package 回填写入,改为只读预演,打印一行"下次服务启动会把哪些行绑到哪个 package"。台账读不到时(例如对尚不存在的库做 plan)只记 debug。
- **为什么改:** QA #32093 在 18.3 → 18.4 升级前跑 `os migrate plan`,平台自己的回填写入被声明启动的写入守卫拒掉,并提示"某插件在 start() 外注册了写入钩子,请把写入挪进 start()"。这个插件并不存在,运维会被引去查一个不存在的 bug;空库上还会多打一行"回填未完成"的警告。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 `@objectstack/objectql` 的回填入口与插件的一处传参;门控沿用 #9380 已有的 `runPlatformMigrations: false`(一次性启动不做任何背后修复)。`os dev` / `os serve` / `os start` 照旧绑定;写入守卫本身未动。patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** ① `packages/objectql/src/activation-ledger-backfill.ts` 的 `previewOnOneShotBoot` 与模块文档新段;② `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` `kernel:bootstrapped` 处的传参;③ `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.activation-ledger-backfill.integration.test.ts`(真实 SQLite,`os migrate plan` 的同款启动)。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build && cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration src/utils/schema-migrate.activation-ledger-backfill.integration.test.ts`,预期 `2 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`backfillActivationLedgerAtBoot` takes the boot's `runPlatformMigrations`.** When it is `false`, the backfill runs as its existing dry run (`backfillActivationLedgerPackages(…, { dryRun: true })`), writes nothing, and logs one `info` line naming each row the next served boot binds and the package it gets: `activation ledger: 1 row(s) name no package, and the next served boot gives each the package that holds its item (ADR-0150 D8); this one-shot boot writes none — flow 'm32096_flow' → com.example.m32096a.` A ledger it cannot read goes to `debug`. Ambiguous and duplicated items are not reported on this boot; the served boot reports them as before. Omitted or `true` (every served boot): unchanged.
- **`ObjectQLPlugin` passes its own `runPlatformMigrations` through** at `kernel:bootstrapped`. `bootSchemaStack` already sets it to `false` on every one-shot boot (#9380: "a boot that must not repair anything behind the operator's back"); `createStandaloneStack` defaults it to `true` for `os dev` / `os serve` / `os start`. No new signal is invented, and nothing in `packages/cli/src/utils/**` changes outside the new test.
- **Module doc** gains the one-shot exclusion beside the existing "never on a kernel that does not seal" rule.
- The declaration boot's write guard is untouched: it still refuses and reports every real plugin write.

**Seat ruling applied:** the card offered two ways; the seat chose "the declaration boot does not run the backfill" plus at most one line naming the rows the served boot will bind. Before this PR the plan reported nothing about pending binds except the misattributed refusal, so the line is new.

Also folded in, approved by the seat as the same gate: on a database that does not exist yet, `os migrate plan` printed `WARN [ObjectQLPlugin] the sys_metadata_activation package backfill did not finish …` (measured on main `8523ef9a`, absent file, plain config). The dry run's read failure now goes to `debug`.

## Pins

Before, on main (`8523ef9a`, then again at `e1146e80` after #32172 merged), both new CLI cases red:

```text
× attempts no backfill write over a row that names no package, blames no plugin, leaves the row, and names the bind the served boot will make
AssertionError: expected [ { …(4) } ] to deeply equal []
+   { "count": 1, "driver": "driver.com.objectstack.driver.sql", "method": "update", "object": "sys_metadata_activation" }
× says nothing about the backfill on a database that does not exist yet: a dry run that cannot read the ledger is not an upgrade that failed
+   "… WARN [ObjectQLPlugin] the sys_metadata_activation package backfill did not finish: rows that name no package keep naming none, …"
```

- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.activation-ledger-backfill.integration.test.ts` (new, integration tier): a compiled artifact whose package `com.example.m32096a` ships the flow `m32096_flow`; a real SQLite file provisioned by a plain `bootSchemaStack`, then one `sys_metadata_activation` row naming no package for that flow (the 18.3.0 shape). The boot `os migrate plan` makes (`deferSchemaDdl`, `readOnlyProbe`, `composeHostStack`, `composeServedPlatform`, `composeDeclaredDatasources`):
  - the write guard records no refusal, no `Refused …()` / `writing hook outside start()` line is printed on any stream, and no composition note blames a plugin;
  - the row is still `package_id: null`, read on our own connection after shutdown;
  - exactly one backfill line, naming `flow 'm32096_flow' → com.example.m32096a` and "next served boot".
  - Over an absent file: no backfill line at all, no refusal, and no file created.
- `packages/objectql/src/activation-ledger-backfill.test.ts`, new describe "on a one-shot boot": no `update`, row still null, the report's `bound` names the row, one `info` line with the "next served boot" wording and none of the served boot's "now name"; an unreadable ledger logs `debug` only; CONTROL: omitted and `true` both bind the row.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed HEAD, objectql rebuilt, both suites run, restore proven (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

<details><summary>A1. The one-shot gate removed in the backfill: 2 objectql pins and both CLI cases red</summary>

```text
replace  "  if (options.runPlatformMigrations === false && !'ablated-1') return previewOnOneShotBoot("  x0 -> x1
× writes nothing, and names in one line the row the next served boot binds and to which package
× a ledger it cannot read is not an upgrade that failed: debug only, no warning
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times
Tests  2 failed | 13 passed (15)
× attempts no backfill write over a row that names no package, …
+   { "count": 1, "driver": "driver.com.objectstack.driver.sql", "method": "update", "object": "sys_metadata_activation" }
× says nothing about the backfill on a database that does not exist yet: …
+   "… WARN [ObjectQLPlugin] the sys_metadata_activation package backfill stopped before writing any row: …"
Tests  2 failed (2)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (ab2c72fa0f6b) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The marker did not survive tsup (esbuild folds `!'ablated-1'` to `false`, so the dist grep read 0 files); the CLI case's refused `update()` is itself the proof the mutation was live in `dist/`, since the gate is the only thing that keeps that write from happening.
</details>

<details><summary>A2. The plugin's pass-through dropped (`'ablated-2' ? undefined : this.runPlatformMigrations`): objectql unit pins green (they call the function directly), both CLI cases red</summary>

```text
dist marker files: 2
Tests  15 passed (15)
× attempts no backfill write over a row that names no package, …
+   { "count": 1, "driver": "driver.com.objectstack.driver.sql", "method": "update", "object": "sys_metadata_activation" }
× says nothing about the backfill on a database that does not exist yet: …
Tests  2 failed (2)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (95665e007aef) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

(The objectql build's dts step exited 1 on the mutated line; the JS dist carried the marker in 2 files, which is what the CLI suite reads.)
</details>

<details><summary>A3. The preview's read failure sent back to `warn`: the objectql debug pin and the CLI absent-database case red</summary>

```text
dist marker files: 2
× a ledger it cannot read is not an upgrade that failed: debug only, no warning
Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)
× says nothing about the backfill on a database that does not exist yet: …
+   "… WARN [ObjectQLPlugin] the sys_metadata_activation package backfill preview could not read the ledger on this one-shot boot; …"
Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (ab2c72fa0f6b) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 72 families for this change set (vs merge base `e1146e80`); all 72 ran with exit 0, and `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles: "72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
  - Three first exited 3 on a prerequisite (a pinned fixture commit outside the shallow clone for `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`; missing `dist/` for `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage`). After `git fetch origin 621a4876` and a full `turbo run build`, all three exited 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched source/test files: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite: 585 files, 12053 tests passed.
- cli integration, the new file and its neighbours (`plan.deferred-reads`, `stored-references`, `duplicates` (byte-identical database after a run), `plan.boot-parity`): 5 files, 21 tests passed.
- Merged `origin/main` once before opening (15 commits, none touching these files).

## Deviations

- File surface widened by one call site, approved by the seat: `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` passes `{ runPlatformMigrations: this.runPlatformMigrations }` to the backfill (3 lines plus a 2-line comment). The signal lives on the plugin, so the backfill cannot read it otherwise.
- The seat's mechanism assumption named "the signal the write-refusal guard knows". The guard knows it is armed only because `bootSchemaStack` composes it, and nothing on the kernel or context exposes that to a platform plugin. The existing signal that marks every `bootSchemaStack` boot to the engine plugin is `runPlatformMigrations: false`, and it means exactly "repairs nothing behind the operator's back", so the gate keys on it. It also covers the one-shot boots that compose no write guard (`bootSchemaStack` arms the guard only with `composeHostStack`), where the backfill would otherwise have written as a side effect of a command the operator ran for something else.
